title: Item 1 · Black Belt money is missing from Finance
subtitle: A Black Belt payment taken at the desk never reaches the Daily report, so at closing the drawer holds money Finance doesn't know about. This can happen on the live site today: the Black Belt screens are live, so staff can already record Black Belt payments there. (Preview screenshots with the fake database · pretend date Mon, Apr 26, 2027 · Shrewsbury)

columns.label: Today

items.caption: 1. At the desk, Bao Nguyen pays his $500 Black Belt payment in cash. The roster takes it: “Payment recorded · $500 · Bao Nguyen”.
2. The same day in Finance: Total $15.00, Cash $0.00. Only a $15 camp card payment is listed. The $500 isn't there.
3. At closing, staff count $500 in the drawer. The dashboard expected $0.00, says “Over $500.00”, and makes them type a note explaining money it should already know about.

columns.note: The payment is saved in Black Belt. It just never reaches Finance: not the Daily report, not History, not Close the day, not the CSV for the bookkeeper.

columns.label: After the fix (mockup)

items.caption: 4. The payment shows in Finance as “Black Belt · Spring 2027 · Payment 2”, on the day it was taken, and the Total and Cash cards include it.
5. At closing, the $500 counted matches what Finance expects. Nothing to explain.

columns.note: Not a new design. Finance already decided this on Oct 19 (rulebook v0.808: the line “Black Belt · cycle · what it's for”; v0.809: a bounced check gets its own “Returned checks” group). It was waiting for Black Belt payments to exist, and they went live on Oct 21. Pictures 4 and 5 are drawn over the real page; nothing in the app was changed.

footer: Who fixes it: the Finance session — one database migration, already planned in its status file. The ready-to-paste prompt is in my phase 1 message. Until then: every Black Belt payment makes that day's count look over by the same amount. Tablet and phone: same screens, only the numbers change.
